There is no enterprise-scale autonomous build and no externally-shipped product with a public URL / real users. That deficit (~6.75 weighted points lost) is the largest single drag on the total. critic.cert_reasoning: Current total sits in the low-70s (my structural read: memory ~6 verified via working memory-sync, oneshot low on one small CLI, most dims mid). Cert requires TWO consecutive blind panels >=98 AND no dimension <9.0. In the current state oneshot (w15) and design (w10) cannot clear 9 without a real external ship — npm whoami returns ENEEDAUTH (owner-only) and SHIPPED.md's high band explicitly needs a public URL + real users; design-proof-app (FR-8) lifted design off its floor but is local-only. That is ~25% of the weight structurally pinned below 9, so the 'no dim <9' clause alone is unsatisfiable now. Independently, closing 73->98 (+25) exceeds the sum of all reachable non-gated levers, and the observed ~6-point blind-panel variance band makes 'twice consecutive >=98' statistically implausible even at a near-ceiling true mean. Not reachable in the current state.

Proven concrete lever: the 160-gate logic surface lives in walteur-kit/hooks/ which is WRITABLE (verified), while .claude/hooks/ (the thin dispatcher) is DENIED — ship-gate.sh:137-138 resolves every gate to $KIT/hooks/$name, so gate hardening is non-gated. critic.verdict: PAUSE-REPORT's 'internal non-gated well is exhausted / cert gated on 2 Tony actions' is partly stale and overstated. Two of its load-bearing claims are already falsified: (1) memory read-side was declared 'GENUINELY GATED behind walteur.js' but was realized NON-gated via memory-sync.sh (B66) — replica byte-identical, --verify passes, recall now returns 36 lessons, memory 4.3->6.0; (2) the loop itself kept finding genuine non-gated levers after the pause (B64 computed-WCAG-contrast gate found+fixed 3 real AA failures; B66) and climbed to a campaign high (~73) at cycle 43, RUNNING not paused. Honest bottom line: keep running the genuine non-gated levers (they materially harden code/design/memory and are worth doing), but certification requires the owner-only external ship (and ideally the tdd-guard unblock to free the gated reliability/orchestration wave).
